verdict: Leads are arriving but not booking — intake gap is the priority fix.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you spent $1,080.52 on Google Ads, generated 105 actions on your Google Business Profile (including 28 direct calls), and your CRM recorded 43 new opportunities — so demand is real. However, none of those 43 opportunities converted to a booked appointment, which points to a gap in how incoming leads are being handled, not a problem with the ads themselves. Ad spend was intentionally reduced this week and is pacing at roughly $32 per day while that intake process is being sorted out. Confirming your intake owner by August 31 is the step that unlocks the ability to scale back up, and heating campaigns are scheduled to go live October 1 ahead of the fall season.
